description: This module manages volumes on Scaleway account https://developer.scaleway.com.

parameters.name: api_timeout
parameters.description: HTTP timeout to Scaleway API in seconds. Default: 30

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: Scaleway OAuth token. This is required if profile is not specified.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name used to identify the volume.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: ScaleWay organization ID to which volume belongs.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: The config profile in config file to load the Scaleway OAuth token from, use instead of api_token. It is also possible to set SCW_PROFILE to use a SCW CLI config profile.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Scaleway project ID to which volume belongs.

parameters.name: query_parameters
parameters.description: List of parameters passed to the query string. Default: {}

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Scaleway region to use (for example par1). Choices: "ams1" "EMEA-NL-EVS" "ams2" "ams3" "par1" "EMEA-FR-PAR1" "par2" "EMEA-FR-PAR2" "par3" "waw1" "EMEA-PL-WAW1" "waw2" "waw3"

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the volume in bytes.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicate desired state of the volume. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Validate SSL certs of the Scaleway API. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create 10GB volume
  community.general.scaleway_volume:
    name: my-volume
    state: present
    region: par1
    project: "{{ scw_org }}"
    "size": 10000000000
    volume_type: l_ssd
  register: server_creation_check_task

- name: Make sure volume deleted
  community.general.scaleway_volume:
    name: my-volume
    state: absent
    region: par1

return_values.name: data
return_values.description: This is only present when state=present. Returned: when state=present Sample: {"volume": {"export_uri": null, "id": "c675f420-cfeb-48ff-ba2a-9d2a4dbe3fcd", "name": "volume-0-3", "project": "000a115d-2852-4b0a-9ce8-47f1134ba95a", "server": null, "size": 10000000000, "volume_type": "l_ssd"}}
